description: GOLDEN PROVENANCE registry (docket SB.2, 019f77117376). Records whether each golden was blessed ONCE by an INDEPENDENT authority (an independent Gerber viewer and/or kicad-cli DRC on the round-tripped board). A golden with blessed=false, or with no entry here, is UNTRUSTED: usable by the geometry-diff harness as a DRIFT PIN, but NEVER as a correctness oracle. See tests/oracle/provenance.py and golden/HOW_TO_BLESS.md.

spike-gerber-v1.method: R6 PASTE + BACK-SILK + EDGE.CUTS BLESS 2026-07-29 (owner, at the machine, in KiCad 10.0.5 GerbView). WHAT THE OWNER ACTUALLY VERIFIED, in their own observations: our F.Paste and KiCad 10's F.Paste coincide exactly with no fringing under XOR; our copper and KiCad's copper likewise; and -- the question they raised unprompted -- paste appears on the SMD lands only, not on the four through-hole pads, which they correctly reasoned was by design. Confirmed by audit of the two-sided fixture: 4 SMD pads (R1 top, R2 BOTTOM), all 4 declaring a paste layer, 4 flashes emitted (2 F.Paste + 2 B.Paste); J1's 4 thru_hole pads declare only *.Cu and *.Mask so neither KiCad nor we paste them. Paste aperture equals the copper land (R,1.0X1.45 both) with no inset -- MEASURED against KiCad, not assumed, for circle/oval/roundrect/rotated-rect as well. TH paste is driven off the pad's declared layer list, not off pad type: a TH pad declaring *.Paste DOES get paste on both sides (verified; a mutation that hardcodes no-paste-for-TH dies). BLESSED SCOPE ADDED: F_Paste, B_Paste, B_SilkS. --- PRIOR: R5 Y-FRAME RE-CUT 2026-07-28 (owner CARRIED THE BLESS FORWARD; no new gerbv overlay). The golden was cut in the OLD mirrored Gerber frame and therefore CERTIFIED A DEFECT: our Y was negated relative to KiCad and the Gerber spec while our aperture rotations were already in the correct frame, so any pad rotated off a 90-degree multiple had its copper turned up to 60 degrees wrong (bug 019fa8011555, comment 873). With the emitter fix reverted, this golden's two oracle tests go GREEN -- it was the last artifact in the repo asserting the defect was correct. Re-cut by the INDEPENDENT generate.py (gerber_writer 0.4.3.3, NOT the emitter under test), per-vertex negation at all 24 write-sites so every path keeps its original start corner and winding. WHY THE 2026-07-24 BLESS CARRIES OVER, measured not argued: the re-cut is a PURE VERTICAL MIRROR -- 46 changed lines, 8 of them regeneration timestamps, 38 pure Y-sign flips, and ZERO anything else (verified mechanically by transforming each old line's Y tokens and asserting byte-equality, with a generator-unmodified control run establishing the 8-timestamp noise floor). Every property the owner blessed is RELATIONAL and was re-measured in the new files with an INDEPENDENT parser (gerbonara), all 30 checks identical: SMD land 1.0x1.45 -> mask 1.1x1.55 = 0.0500 mm/side; U1 annulus 1.6 -> mask 1.7 = 0.0500 mm/side; NPTH mount Ø3.2 drill-size opening, delta 0.0; via tented with EMPTY mask openings on both sides; both plated holes concentric (Ø0.8 ring 0.400, Ø0.4 ring 0.200). --- PRIOR: R4b re-bless 2026-07-24 (owner, relayed by Claude-Opus): F_Mask/B_Mask openings re-cut from 0.1mm to the RATIFIED 0.05mm/side clearance (bug 019f91f9e89c). Owner blessed via a gerbv-rendered BEFORE(0.1)/AFTER(0.05) overlay of F_Mask over F_Cu (copper vs mask ring) at the U1 TH pad + R1 SMD pads, plus the measurement table: SMD land 1.0x1.45 -> mask 1.1x1.55; U1 annulus 1.6 -> mask 1.7; NPTH mount (5,5) Ø3.2 drill-size opening UNCHANGED; via (20,10) tented, no opening. Independent corroboration: production build_fab(spike) == this golden on ALL fabrication-critical layers (copper/mask/drill/edge, 0 GeometryDiff deltas). A kicad-cli cross-check corroborated the NPTH drill-size opening but revealed the KiCad emitter applies 0mm plated-pad clearance (filed 019f9266b9cd, separate) — that does NOT affect this GERBER golden.
spike-gerber-v1.notes: R6 CHANGE CLASSIFICATION, every byte, with a generator-unmodified CONTROL run establishing the noise floor. CONTROL: 8 changed lines, ALL regeneration timestamps, 0 else. RE-CUT: those same 8 timestamps + exactly 2 lines in board-Edge_Cuts.gbr ('%ADD10C,0.1*%' -> '%ADD10C,0.05*%' and its matching TAShape comment) + 0 anything else. Verified INDEPENDENTLY by the orchestrator: with timestamp lines stripped, board-F_Cu / B_Cu / F_Mask / B_Mask / F_SilkS / PTH.drl / NPTH.drl are sha256-IDENTICAL to the previously blessed files. NO copper, mask, silk or drill byte moved. Three files ADDED: board-F_Paste.gbr (4 flashes, R,1.0X1.45, coordinates byte-identical to KiCad's), board-B_Paste.gbr and board-B_SilkS.gbr (valid, aperture-less, empty -- KiCad emits empty layers too rather than omitting them). The Edge.Cuts stroke change is BOOKKEEPING not a defect: the owner ruled it fabrication-immaterial on 2026-07-29 (comment 877 on 019fa73b1470) because board houses route the outline centreline. ANTI-CIRCULARITY PRESERVED: re-cut by the INDEPENDENT generate.py (gerber_writer 0.4.3.3), NOT the emitter under test. STILL-OPEN GAP THE OWNER DID NOT BLESS AND MUST NOT BE READ AS COVERED: solder_paste_margin_ratio is silently dropped by footprints.py -- not parsed, not flagged unsupported. ~170 of KiCad's ~15,400 shipped footprints use it. Neither fixture exercises one, so nothing in this bless is affected, but those pads would get paste equal to copper instead of ratio-adjusted. A stencil-house blocker, filed separately. --- COVERAGE GAPS IN THIS GOLDEN, recorded 2026-07-28 because they bound what a green oracle here proves: it contains NO ARCS (G02/G03 count is 0 in all 8 files; every path is G01) and NO ROTATED PADS (generate.py never passes the `angle` argument to add_pad, so every pad is at rotation 0). It therefore certifies the POSITION half of the Y-frame fix and is STRUCTURALLY BLIND to the chirality and rotation halves -- including the up-to-60-degree wrong copper that was the actual defect. That half is pinned only by test_aperture_rotation_agrees_with_pad_pair_bearing, not by this blessed reference. Extending the spike board with a rotated pad and an arc would make the one blessed correctness oracle actually cover the defect class that shipped. --- RE-BLESSED by owner 2026-07-24 at the ratified 0.05mm mask clearance (019f91f9e89c). board-F_Mask.gbr + board-B_Mask.gbr were re-cut from 0.1mm to 0.05mm per-side solder-mask clearance to match PRODUCTION. The owner ratified 0.05mm (the compile->IR fab path pins solder_mask_clearance_mm=0.05 from compile_board's v1 manufacturing floor, compile_board._V1_MANUFACTURING_FLOOR, and ignores any authored value; the prior golden was cut at the legacy 0.1mm raw-path DEFAULT_MASK_CLEARANCE_MM, so a green correctness oracle certified the RETIRED raw path, not user-facing CAM — 24 F.Mask/B.Mask deltas). The re-cut is INDEPENDENT (gerber_writer 0.4.3.3 generate.py MASK_CLEARANCE=0.05, NOT the emitter under test — anti-circularity preserved) and VERIFIED: production build_fab(spike) == this golden on ALL fabrication-critical layers (copper/mask/drill/edge, 0 deltas); only cosmetic F.SilkS diverges. The correctness oracle (tests/oracle/test_provenance.py) is re-pointed to the PRODUCTION build_fab path; the owner RE-BLESSED at 0.05mm on 2026-07-24 (gerbv before/after overlay + measurement table + programmatic prod==golden proof), so it is now a LIVE correctness assertion. --- PRIOR BLESS (SUPERSEDED, for history): RE-BLESSED by owner 2026-07-23 (E3 NPTH-mask ratification, docket 019f901a9966). The ONLY delta vs the prior 2026-07-19 bless: board-F_Mask.gbr + board-B_Mask.gbr each gained a DRILL-SIZE Ø3.2 solder-mask opening over the bare NPTH mounting hole at (5,5) — every through-hole entity now gets a mask opening, matching kicad's np_thru_hole (verified vs pcbnew 9.0.9: an np_thru_hole pad IS on F.Mask/B.Mask with a size==drill opening). The U1 Ø1.6 TH pad, Ø0.8/Ø0.4 PTH drills, Ø3.2 NPTH drill, the four real 0805 SMD lands (1.0x1.45mm), VCC/GND traces, and the 40x30 Edge_Cuts are UNCHANGED from the prior bless. ANTI-CIRCULARITY: the F_Mask/B_Mask layers were regenerated by the INDEPENDENT generate.py (gerber_writer 0.4.3.3), NOT the emitter under test (pcb_worker.gerber, pygerber) — different code paths; the correctness test asserts LIVE that emitter(resolved spike) == this golden on copper/mask/drill/edge (0 deltas). This is the TRUSTED correctness oracle for FABRICATION-CRITICAL geometry. ORACLE SCOPE (Option A): the correctness test asserts copper/mask/drill/edge via GeometryDiff.excluding_layers('F_SilkS'); silk is EXCLUDED (THIS golden draws courtyard outlines procedurally; the production emitter draws NONE — K4 retired the courtyard placeholder — and gerber-writer cannot render silk text at all) — real silk correctness is tracked separately (silk-text 019f77fd6d69; coverage audit 019f77fd9c6c). Pad bug 019f7736b236 remains CLOSED in the oracle sense (the emitter provably reproduces the blessed geometry via resolve). See hint pcb-cam-emitter/th-pad-mask-pcbnew-truth.

emitter-snapshot-v1.notes: DRIFT-PIN ONLY — captured from the emitter under test (pcb_worker.gerber.build_gerbers via scripts/capture_emitter_golden.py). Inherently circular: it can detect FUTURE drift in the emitter but can NEVER attest correctness. blessed stays false PERMANENTLY by design; do NOT bless this entry. The correctness reference is spike-gerber-v1.

cam-excellon-ipc356-v1.method: OWNER bless 2026-07-18. DRILLS+SLOT: full independent VISUAL confirmation in gerbv (/opt/homebrew/bin/gerbv) overlaid on board frame + F_Cu — both plated holes (Ø0.8 @ U1, Ø0.4 @ via) concentric inside their copper pads, routed slot ~4x1mm @ lower-right, bare Ø3.2 NPTH mount @ lower-left. IPC-356: confirmed as SYMBOLIC net-membership match to the design source board.yaml (VCC={U1.1,R1.2}, GND={R1.1,C1.1}) + test-point locations == already-blessed pad centers. NOT independently visualized as scalable geometry.
cam-excellon-ipc356-v1.notes: BLESSED WITH CAVEAT (owner, 2026-07-18, docket 019f777e9206). DRILLS+SLOT: high confidence — fully visually verified in gerbv. IPC-356: MODERATE confidence WITH DOCUMENTED CAVEAT — the owner could verify it only as symbolic 'pure math' net-membership (matches board.yaml source) + locations (== already-blessed pads), NOT as scalable visible geometry, because NO IPC-356 -> visual verification tool exists yet (tracked in 019f77aa012e; that tool would render net-colored test points spatially so a netlist can be blessed the way drills were). Owner: 'I believe, with some uncertainty, that it is correct.' Emitted by the RATIFIED gerbonara coupon (spikes/cam/emit_golden.py -> gerbonara_coupon.build()). Satisfies CAM ratification condition 1. Contents: PTH = Ø0.8mm plated @ (30.0,15.0) [U1 TH] + Ø0.4mm plated @ (20.0,10.0) [via] + a Ø1.0mm plated routed SLOT (34.0,5.0)->(38.0,5.0); NPTH = Ø3.2mm bare @ (5.0,5.0) [mount]; IPC-356 = 4 records: U1.1 VCC through-hole Ø0.8 plated @ (30.0,15.0) access-both, R1.2 VCC SMD @ (10.95,10.0) top, R1.1 GND SMD @ (9.05,10.0) top, C1.1 GND SMD @ (9.05,20.0) top. ANTI-CIRCULARITY CAVEAT: emitted by gerbonara and the Stage-5 PRODUCTION emitter will ALSO be gerbonara-based (different code path — pcb_worker over the ResolvedBoard IR), so this golden catches INTEGRATION / driving divergence (wrong params/geometry from the IR) but NOT gerbonara LIBRARY bugs (those are tracked in 019f7773257 and caught by the owner's INDEPENDENT gerbv bless of drills+slot + IPC-356 record review). CORRECTNESS CONSUMER: the Stage-5 production Excellon/slots/IPC-356 emitter (019f761fefae) — which does NOT exist yet, so no correctness comparison is possible today. Until BOTH the owner blesses (blessed=true) AND that consumer exists, the correctness-oracle test skips-with-reason; a coupon-vs-its-own-output check is a drift/reproducibility pin ONLY, never a correctness claim. Do NOT self-bless — see golden/HOW_TO_BLESS_EXCELLON.md; flag open Excellon-header bug 019f7720928d during the drill check.
